[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Plugin-extensible task bead types[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every new task bead carries a required, plugin-extensible [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`task_type` whose declared fields, validators, and body template [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]are validated in the Rust core; the effective catalog is a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]deterministic function of a project's committed configuration [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]rather than of whichever plugins happen to be installed on the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]current machine; and every surface that shows a task bead shows a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]distinctly colored type chip.[/#D7D7AF]
